tools.name: list_family_almanac_feeds
tools.description: List The Family Almanac's free machine-readable feeds and their MCP/REST availability. OpenAPI is also published at https://thefamilyalmanac.com/openapi.json.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search or list the parenting-focused book library by title/author substring and/or classifier tag. No filters returns the first page.

tools.name: get_library_work
tools.description: Returns one parenting library work's bibliographic record and (when profiled) its thesis.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Returns one live guide's title, subtitle, access, book count, and reading time — card-level metadata only. This surface never returns guide body/depth text (none is served here, free or gated); to read or purchase a guide, send the reader to the returned canonicalUrl — never summarize or excerpt con

tools.name: get_magazine_piece
tools.description: Returns one published magazine piece's question, per-writer sections, and editor's coda — the same content the human page renders, ungated. Known slugs (4): the-whole-room--i-got-a-prenatal-screening-result-that-came, the-whole-room--my-baby-won-t-nap-anywhere-except-on, the-whole-room--four-year-ol

tools.name: get_membership_offer
tools.description: Get The Family Almanac's Bicycle Cooperative membership offer for the Parenting chapter — five options (enterprise member, practitioner member, worker, practitioner rent, enterprise rent) with chapter-substituted copy, resolved action labels, and the join URL. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_family_almanac_feeds, get_membership_offer · Private data: get_library_work · Public sink: get_guide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_family_almanac_feeds, get_membership_offer · Private data: get_library_work · Public sink: get_guide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
